questions.qtext:
There are four water tanks each with equal capacity of 1200 liters. The water is being pumped from one tank to another as per the following scheme.
From P to Q at the rate 52 liters/second
From P to S at the rate 48 liters/second
From Q to R at the rate 36 liters/second
From R to P at the rate 76 liters/second
From R to S at the rate 24 liters/second
From S to Q at the rate 48 liters/second

If all the pumps are started simultaneously when each of the tanks has 384 liters of water, which tank would get emptied first?
questions.solution:
Now, let’s calculate the net flow of the water in each of the tanks.
P : 76 – 100 = –24 litres/second
Q : 100 – 36 = 64 litres/second
R : 36 – 100 = –64 litres/second
S : 72 – 48 = 24 litres/second
It shows that R gives away 64 liters/second, so will be emptied first and the time taken
= 384/64 = 6 seconds
